preservation.ui: Build 394 layouts, styles and controls preserved. Only citation/shared-popup focus ownership is corrected after the real browser regression test failed.
preservation.b4: Only the evidence source hash changes. Draft wording remains unaccepted.

sourceSnapshot.limit: The report declares a data hash, not this Git commit. Equality establishes the evidence snapshot, not the entire producing checkout.

verification.selectedAssessments: All cited passage wording and context read in current packaged KJV, ASV and WEB.
verification.limits: Other report assessments, earlier Hebrew/Greek claims, Brenton quotations, historical events and manuscript claims were not recertified.
verification.mappingMethod: Report-listed stable IDs were checked for exact existence. Groups without listed IDs remain unmapped, except the accepted burning-bush review matched by subject and all cited ranges. Empty currentRecordIds does not establish that the application has no equivalent.
